texts.name: Fredrik
texts.biography: Fredrik Lokesson, also known as Eagle-Eye, might be the oldest Dwarf soldier alive: he has been a scout in Grimheim's army for nearly four hundred years. While his many feats-of-arms would have guaranteed him a place among the elder council of his clan, Fredrik has been living in the wilderness for so long he can't stand to sleep with a roof above his head anymore. He now leads a group of similarly-minded veterans, calling themselves the Old and the Bold.

specialty.name: Brawlers
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Brawlers, Berserkers, and Battleragers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
